text: Mr Hobb was lonely. Tessa said, “I want to give the birthday cake to Mr Hobb.” Mrs Pike said, “I need the wicker basket.” Tessa borrowed the wicker basket. The birthday cake was in the wicker basket. Tessa waited beside the paved path. The birthday cake's icing was smudged. Tessa put the birthday cake on the kitchen table. Mr Hobb said, “I am pleased.” He lit the candle. Tessa returned the wicker basket to Mrs Pike. Mr Hobb opened the window. The candle glowed.
